paths.title: Dry run over 10 goal-relevant tool(s)
paths.rationale: Dry run: no LLM was used. One happy path over the allowed tools that share vocabulary with the scenario, most relevant first, at most max_tool_calls=10: find_product, get_product, get_product_origins, origin_triage, list_products, rank_products_by_origin, list_origin_submissions, pipeline_status, list_recipes, get_recipe. The scout already proved these expected-outcome lookups answer, so they come first: find_product. Arguments named by a top-level expected_outcome.json key with a plain value take that value: find_product(query="penne"); other required arguments take schema placeholders. Skipped because the description says they cost money/credits or are slow: plan_recipe, plan_from_text, plan_week.
